lxc_cd073883cd1997b0.text: Shaquille O'Neal, Yao Ming, Magic Johnson, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama and Rui Hachimura show different ways to play basketball.

lxc_eee2a3cb3a606c9d.text: We can compare their size, their jobs on the court, their playing styles, their countries and their times in the game.

lxc_a24858302464d705.text: Shaquille O'Neal, also called Shaq, is from the USA.

lxc_0407fe68c45a6549.text: He was a huge, strong center, 2.16 m tall.

lxc_9eea7cda02ffd708.text: A center often plays close to the basket.

lxc_70970c5a4a652271.text: Shaq used his power to dunk.

lxc_0dcf4b68d48e889d.text: A dunk means putting the ball down through the basket from above.

lxc_20ffbb18ec90e590.text: He was a star in the 1990s and 2000s.

lxc_25a4c41867b3fbec.text: He played for the Orlando Magic, then the Los Angeles Lakers, then the Miami Heat.

lxc_48d164d19a48843b.text: With the Lakers, he won three titles in a row, from 2000 to 2002.

lxc_4d47333a6cfc83ba.text: He later entered the Hall of Fame, which honors great basketball people.

lxc_ba54fa6639599a62.text: Yao Ming is from Shanghai, China.

lxc_272d43b75eb3932b.text: At 2.29 m, he was even taller than Shaq.

lxc_fe79a16160b43aca.text: He was also a center, but power was not his only skill.

lxc_8ee80f3653082a56.text: He had a soft shooting touch.

lxc_ad841368ff8322ac.text: This means he could shoot the ball gently and with good control.

lxc_181ed41c95c7fad1.text: In 2002, the Houston Rockets chose him first in the NBA Draft.

lxc_c976e6e12b38bc58.text: The draft is how NBA teams choose new players.

lxc_e87113c2f8534804.text: Yao helped make the NBA hugely popular in China.

lxc_2f06120a871cb1d0.text: Foot and ankle injuries ended his career in 2011.

lxc_bf9de31e23a5191f.text: His story shows that a very tall player can also be a careful shooter.

lxc_7a8f2ec48da4d4ff.text: Magic Johnson is from the USA.

lxc_344a632badd3feca.text: He was a 2.06 m point guard, very tall for that job.

lxc_bb4be5521fe43aae.text: A point guard leads the team's attack and passes the ball to other players.

lxc_b5c56ee29aa4417d.text: Unlike Shaq and Yao, Magic used his height in this leading role.

lxc_a526e9b51bdcf9c0.text: His Los Angeles Lakers were famous in the 1980s for Showtime.

lxc_f5b0cfde60709c8f.text: This was a fast, exciting style with quick attacks, called fast breaks.

lxc_272b070d65eff22d.text: He passed without looking at the player receiving the ball.

lxc_8e7ffe077269996b.text: He won five titles and won Olympic gold with the 1992 Dream Team.

lxc_6547f130883abd45.text: Stephen Curry is a point guard from the USA.

lxc_03b8d0cef9d01978.text: At only 1.88 m, he is small for the NBA.

lxc_8c363e290da113b2.text: He has played for the Golden State Warriors since 2009.

lxc_421446f1a3329c80.text: His special skill is the three-pointer, a shot from beyond the three-point line.

lxc_5a13d3f6bac0b842.text: Curry has made more three-pointers than anyone in NBA history.

lxc_6e9dac1b9f49f368.text: He changed how teams play: many now shoot far more threes.

lxc_5a7051683fcb93fb.text: He has four titles and two MVP awards.

lxc_16676f88a1e8abc0.text: He won Olympic gold at Paris 2024.

lxc_8ad8cbf6adaa9269.text: At 38, he is still playing, with a new deal through 2028–29.

lxc_847d403d8a035926.text: He was born in 2004 and is 2.24 m tall.

lxc_1e620a91434a2c12.text: The San Antonio Spurs chose him first in the 2023 NBA Draft.

lxc_db7b29d5a1acca14.text: He belongs to today's new era of basketball.

lxc_4bf031ac5bdcb765.text: He blocks shots like a center.

lxc_31d89bc603a3ac8a.text: A block stops another player's shot from reaching the basket.

lxc_9c006cc243209003.text: But he also dribbles and shoots three-pointers like a guard.

lxc_5b2764f7b5979f67.text: Dribbling means moving with the ball while bouncing it.

lxc_2ac3262aa14b7aef.text: His skills bring different roles together.

lxc_caefd1885f0afe74.text: He won Defensive Player of the Year for 2025–26, an award for the best player at stopping the other team.

lxc_3877a1707329bf39.text: Rui Hachimura is from Toyama, Japan.

lxc_d5566e78e3a54e85.text: He is 2.03 m tall and plays forward.

lxc_58a7f8a36a26ce32.text: A forward can help near the basket and farther away.

lxc_ade6e14a642dc0f1.text: Rui is a good shooter, so shooting is an important part of his game.

lxc_bb9db8a19d322d25.text: He played college basketball at Gonzaga University in the USA.

lxc_3c7b4db88f69557d.text: In 2019, the Washington Wizards chose him in the NBA Draft.

lxc_e902a051395d63a7.text: He became the first Japanese player chosen in the first round.

lxc_26b59271ad757261.text: He later played for the Los Angeles Lakers.

lxc_463b32c76fd6c889.text: Since July 2026, he has been with the Los Angeles Clippers.

lxc_e8a063b52680d256.text: His path connects Japanese basketball with today's NBA.
